# Local skill validation fixtures

These small, synthetic directories exercise THRN's read-only local validator. The
`frontend-design` fixture copies only frontmatter fields from
[`anthropics/skills` at commit `ca45fc496a3436251f191354091d557da31c15b5`](https://github.com/anthropics/skills/blob/ca45fc496a3436251f191354091d557da31c15b5/skills/frontend-design/SKILL.md);
its body is synthetic. It is not a copy of the upstream skill or any referenced license text.
